purpose: Precise implementation binders so Software can implement without new decisions.

implementationSpecBinder.digestSchema: JSON exactly: schemaVersion(int=1), shotId(string), config(object passed to run_shot), metrics(get_metrics output), modelVersion('0.1.0'), sourceFingerprint, engine('python/d3gate'), regression{status PASS|FAIL, maxRelativeError, firstFailure|null}
implementationSpecBinder.manifestSchema: JSON exactly: schemaVersion(int=2), batchId(experiments/sweeps/<id>), createdAt, config(pinned), cases[{shotId,config}], runtimeVersions{python,node}, pyengineApprovalHash('71787da902190d6038460bbb2d46a0dc810a8a4e91a12ced9b38fe7ea9f1fd54'), engineFingerprint(sha256 of engine.py bytes), modelVersion('0.1.0'), sourceFingerprint, digests[{shotId,path,sha256}], regressionSummary, jevResult{callCount=1, model, scores, status}, go(boolean)
implementationSpecBinder.tsReferenceInvocation: REUSE d3gate.engine._node + _API_URL/_ENGINE_URL (existing node --input-type=module bridge importing physics/api.ts / engine.ts, cwd=REPO, JSON round-trip) per case; no new subprocess design. Compare python run_shot vs TS run_shot.
implementationSpecBinder.engineFingerprintMethod: sha256 of python/d3gate/engine.py bytes at batch start; mismatch vs pyengine-approval binding = hard no-go
implementationSpecBinder.configValidation: REUSE engine._normalize for every case (grid int 17-129 odd, dt>0 and <=0.01, controls whitelisted LIMITS keys + bounds); invalid case => fail the batch. Sweep uses engine.parameter_sweep(config, control, values).
implementationSpecBinder.digestFields: REUSE engine.get_metrics + SAMPLE_FIELDS (t,ip,ne,te,ti,we,wi,nbi,ech,pOhm,pLoss,pRad,tauE,pressure,beta,energyError,particleError) as the 17 regression fields; MODEL_VERSION asserted '0.1.0'.
implementationSpecBinder.comparisonBudget: pointwise relative 1e-6 over 251x17; aggregate metrics 1e-9; conservation/equilibrium as specs/proposals/pyengine.md; record max error + first failing case/field/sample
implementationSpecBinder.cliContract: python -m d3gate.sweep [--config PATH] [--limit N]; --limit N expands+prints first N ordered cases, exits with zero engine/network/write; default writes experiments/sweeps/<id>/{manifest.json,digests/<id>.json} plus flagged full shots only; any invalid case or engine exception fails the batch (no partial pass).
implementationSpecBinder.defaultCaseList: baseline + ip in {0.9,1.2,1.5} x nbi in {2,4,6} = 10 ordered cases, gridSize 49, dt 0.002, all within LIMITS; ~1-2s on the laptop.
implementationSpecBinder.jevGate: one call to tools/teamflow/jev.mjs, jev-latest, questions = rubric (c1-sweep-harness.rubric.json validate/implement custom set is for audits; the sweep uses the spec's embedded 4-question set: digest_complete, reference_regression_ready, physics_scope_respected, retain_full_shot; min 0.75); state = manifest + digests only; any below-threshold or unavailable/malformed => no-go; no success-shaped fallback.

amendments.old: 'python -m d3gate.sweep' fails from repo root (python/ not on sys.path)
amendments.new: package.json 'pyengine:sweep' runs 'PYTHONPATH=python python3 -m d3gate.sweep'; direct invocation equivalent documented
amendments.evidence: python/d3gate/sweep.py unchanged for this; package.json scripts.pyengine:sweep

amendments.old: engine._normalize whitelists LIMITS keys but does NOT bounds-check values, so out-of-bounds controls (e.g. ip=99) reached the engine
amendments.new: sweep._validate_controls enforces each control value within engine.LIMITS[key][0..1] before any engine call; invalid case fails the whole batch

amendments.what: retain_full_shot is a flag, not a gate question
amendments.old: all four questions min 0.75 made retain_full_shot gate-fatal: a clean digest (retain=false => score ~0.05) always failed the gate, so go was always false on the intended clean path
amendments.new: Jev gate PASS judged on the three audit questions (digest_complete, reference_regression_ready, physics_scope_respected) only; retain_full_shot >= 0.75 adds the shot to full-shot retention; ALSO any gate-question score < 0.75 for a case flags that case for retention (Jev-evaluated non-clean case deserves full-shot evidence)

amendments.what: Jev one-batch gate now shells out through the bound API (tools/teamflow/jev.mjs)
amendments.old: sweep used d3gate.jev.JevClient.evaluate (Python port); pieces of the JE-v1 audit (spec line 75-76, design-review acceptanceCriteria.jev, jevGate binder entry) bind the sweep to tools/teamflow/jev.mjs, so the implementation deviated from the approved spec binding
amendments.new: tools/teamflow/jev.mjs gained a minimal 'evaluate' CLI (stdin {state,questions,model} -> stdout API response JSON; Director-scope, Director-implemented); sweep._run_jev shells out to 'node tools/teamflow/jev.mjs evaluate' once per sweep and decodes {'noul': prob} plus score/value/confidence/answer shapes. Same one-call/min-0.75/no-fallback contract; no per-shot calls
